purpose: Register of known, harmless non-artifact files left on experiment hosts by tooling. Each entry is DECLARED here rather than deleted on the remote host, per the standing no-remote-deletion rule. A file listed here has no manifest identity and no evidentiary value; it must not be mistaken for an experiment output.

rule: Declare, do not delete. A remote deletion is irreversible and is not authorised for a housekeeping file; a declaration is sufficient and reversible. If a future sweep wants a clean tree, the correct move is to note the file here and leave it.
